title: Extensions
newFromTemplate: Create a plugin from a template
newFromTemplateBody: Choose a starting point. Files are created in your chosen folder, the plugin is loaded, and the folder opens as a project. Your next edit takes effect immediately.
newFromTemplateOpened: {{name}} created and loaded; its folder is open for development

templateBody.panel-basic: A command that opens a panel: a minimal working plugin.
templateBody.agent-tool-basic: Register a tool an agent can call and describe its parameters with JSON Schema.
templateBody.skill-pack: A Markdown skill added to the agent's system prompt when relevant.
templateBody.full-demo: Panels, commands, agent tools, skills and settings, demonstrating each extension point.

permissionHelp.ui.panel: Allow the plugin to show a panel inside the application.
permissionHelp.clipboard.read: May read the current clipboard and clipboard history retained while the application is running.
permissionHelp.clipboard.write: May replace the current clipboard contents.
permissionHelp.notify: Can show in-app notices and system notifications when available.
permissionHelp.fs.read: Read-only access to paths declared by the plugin. Credentials and repository internals are always excluded.
permissionHelp.fs.write: Can create or modify files in declared paths. Other paths require your permission each time.
permissionHelp.fs.delete: Can delete files in declared paths or files it created. Files go to the system trash; other paths require your permission each time.
permissionHelp.fs.read.workspace: Can only read files in the current project.
permissionHelp.fs.write.workspace: Declared before scoped file access was introduced. Cannot write anywhere until the plugin is updated.
permissionHelp.fs.delete.workspace: Declared before scoped file access was introduced. Can now only delete files it created.
permissionHelp.agent.tool.register: Allow AI agents to call additional tools provided by this plugin.
permissionHelp.agent.prompt.inject: May modify instructions sent to agents.
permissionHelp.agent.complete: Uses your model quota to request a completion. The plugin cannot access your API key.
permissionHelp.models.list: Can see models you are signed in to, but cannot access their keys.
permissionHelp.session.read: Can read the conversation sent to the model for this tool call, including tool results.
permissionHelp.shell.openExternal: Can open links in your default browser.
permissionHelp.ui.theme: Adds a selectable theme to settings. Changes appearance only and does not access data.
permissionHelp.mcp.server.local: Starts a local program that provides additional tools to agents.
permissionHelp.mcp.server.remote: Sends tool calls to the remote MCP endpoint declared by the plugin. The endpoint may use unencrypted HTTP.
permissionHelp.background.service: Keeps a background worker running while the plugin is enabled.
permissionHelp.bus.publish: Can send messages on declared topics.
permissionHelp.bus.subscribe: Can receive messages on declared topics.
permissionHelp.browser.cdp: Can navigate the workspace browser, read pages, run JavaScript and send allowed Chrome DevTools commands. Cookie and storage methods are blocked.
